newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks climb but correction could return.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks climb but correction could return.

text.p: Madrid stock indices reversed early losses to close higher on Tuesday boosted by gains on Wall Street and bonds. In the short-term traders could not rule out a return of the correction seen in recent sessions.
The general index closed up 8.27 points, 1.80 percent, to 466.47. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares rose 99.97 points, 1.9 percent, to 5,353.83. Turnover reached 93 billion pesetas.

"The U.S. data stopped the correction in its tracks, but the market is still not as firm as we saw some weeks ago and falls in stocks such as Repsol raise doubts about the short-term," said one trader.
The U.S. employment cost index rose below expectations 0.8 percent in the fourth quarter, easing fears about inflation and interest rate rises in the U.S..
Repsol bucked the trend, falling 100 pesetas, 1.7 percent, to 5,780, in what traders saw as a continuing correction to recent gains.
Among other stocks, electricity and banks recorded strong gains. Popular rose 3.8 percent and Santander and BBV rose 2.5 percent.
Endesa rose 180 pesetas to 9,480, while Sevillana gained 40 pesetas to 1,350.
